house
------------------------------------------
It is but natural for every गृहस्थ or householder to construct his own होउसे and live there. The गृह्यसूत्रस् and the पुराणस् have dealt with almost all the aspects—except the engineering details—involved in the construction and entering it. Selection of a suitable site, starting of the construction, the various stages in the same and entering the new होउसे are the subjects dealt with.
The construction must be begun on an auspicious day in the śuklapakṣa or the bright fortnight of उत्तरायण (northern solstice) and when the nakṣatras like रोहिणी, Uttaraphālgunī or Uttarāṣāḍhā are present.
The Matsyapurāṇa (25

) states the results of beginning the construction of a होउसे in the twelve months from चैत्र (March-April) onwards. For instance, if it is begun in आषाढ (July), the owner will gain in cattle and will get good servants. If in चैत्र, he suffers from diseases and so on.
Nakṣatras which are auspicious as also those which are inauspicious, have also been mentioned.
The rules regarding entering a new house—gṛhapraveśa—are observed even now.
See also GṚHAPRAVEŚA.
